specificFindings: Novembercurrent self-ratings and Novemberrecollections of the semester beginning are separate measures. The comparison is with actual earlier ratings,not assumed perfectly accurate memory or somebody elses traits.

September6.35is higher than November6.05,whereas the later rememberedSeptember rating5.74is lower. These are self-evaluation scores on an11point scale,not automatically objective performance changes or GPA.

The Wilson/Rosspaper subtitle names appraisals of earlier and present selves. Chump to Champ is a title,not by itself proof every real ability improved. The borrowed story-editing terminology belongs toTimWilson rather than an assertion that same-surname researchers are identical.
Derogation describes lower evaluation of the past self as one editing method,not praise of the past at the presents expense or a requirement to erase all memories.

The authors shyness example remains personal and qualified by Ithink; less shy is not no longer shy. Better writer is relative to his own age25self,not objectively best worldwide or an independent writing competition.

Many domains include maturity,writing,andmorality. The conditional marathon runner and hypothetical record illustrate constraints from objective results,not certified race times personally achieved by the author.

The college-semester example is an illustration of known grades limiting a growth story when grades did not improve. It is not a universal guarantee of perfect recall or an instruction to alter official records.
Even objective measures retain appeal for growth narratives in the author transition. TimWilson/PatriciaLinville are distinguished fromAnneWilson/MichaelRoss,Decety,andHong/LinSiegler.

The interviewees2.0to2.6to3.2is a single reported GPA progression,not every experimental participants measured sequence or the earlier6.35/6.05/5.74ratings. The otherhalf does not receive the GPAinformation; this does not mean they were excluded from subsequent questionnaires or tests.

The role model has faced similar difficulties and later succeeded. Can provide idea and hope preserves possibility without guaranteeing identical final grades. The key edited object is how students interpreted poor first-semester academic performance,not retroactive change to official grades.

Physics is tough for most,not permanently impossible for all. Identify with means relate to the person,not recognise a spelling or claim authorship of relativity. The retained linear source E=mc2 corresponds to the superscripted formula on the actual page; no new physics derivation is introduced.

Einstein dissatisfaction and attempted electromagnetic/gravitational integration are presented as this books historical account. Tried does not mean completed; despite25years contrasts effort and failure of that particular goal,not all of his scientific contributions.

The scientist-story conditions differ in students beliefs about hardwork versus born genius. Thought identifies their reported interpretations rather than a biological experiment proving all sources of ability. The two conditions and comparison direction are not exchanged.

Numerous interventions in diverse settings since1982does not guarantee every intervention works for every individual or claim an independently updated current review. For me marks the authors main lesson: control of narrative,not control of all past events or all future outcomes.
